hooks.name: Static quality chain on stop
hooks.description: Report-only static analysis when the agent stops: typecheck, exact pinned deps, ESLint, size limits, layer boundaries, 0 runtime cycles, 0 dead exports/types/CSS, declarative rules, 0 duplicate blocks, legacy-name guard, and brand guard. Runs every step, prints a FAILED line per failing step, always exits 0. The blocking gate is npm run quality.

action.command: f=0; for c in 'npx tsc --noEmit' 'node scripts/quality/check-deps.mjs' 'npm run quality:lint' 'node scripts/quality/check-size.mjs src scripts/desktop' 'node scripts/quality/check-layers.mjs' 'node scripts/quality/check-cycles.mjs' 'node scripts/quality/check-deadcode.mjs' 'node scripts/quality/check-declarative.mjs' 'npm run quality:dup' 'node scripts/quality/check-legacy-name.mjs' 'node scripts/quality/check-brands.mjs'; do sh -c "$c" 2>&1 || { f=$((f+1)); echo "FAILED (report-only): run $c"; }; done; if [ "$f" -eq 0 ]; then echo 'quality chain: all steps passed'; else echo "quality chain: $f step(s) FAILED (report-only, see above)"; fi; exit 0
